Gifu, Japan · Winter 2027

Shirakawa-go Light-Up 2027

What to know before you plan it

The dates

Only 4 evenings

Jan 11 · Jan 17
Jan 24 · Jan 31, 2027

Lights on 5:30–7:30 pm

Source: Shirakawa-go Tourist Association, Nohi Bus

The big rule

You can't just turn up

In 2026 the light-up was reservation-only. Same-day visitors without a reservation were turned away, even by bus, taxi or car.

Expect the same in 2027. Check the official 2027 rules before you go.

Easiest way in

Official bus tour from Takayama

  • Nohi Bus runs tours on all 4 dates
  • From 13,000 yen per person
  • Online booking only; sales open in stages, Oct 13 – Nov 2, 2026, at 2 pm Japan time

Want the classic view?

Observation deck needs a ticket

Deck tickets aren't sold on the day. Among the Nohi Bus tours, only Course B includes the deck.

It's about a 20-minute walk up each way, in the snow.
